attempts.summary: Created a dedicated systemd service `inventory-worker` on node1 running a long-lived background worker as an unprivileged system user (`inventory`), sandboxed with NoNewPrivileges=yes and filesystem confinement (root filesystem read-only via ProtectSystem=full + ReadOnlyDirectories=/, with only /var/lib/inventory writable via ReadWriteDirectories=). Verified the worker persistently writes only inside /var/lib/inventory. Completed the mandatory node1 restart protocol: captured baseline boot_id and healthy service/data state, issued a native reboot, confirmed the boot_id changed, and verified the service auto-recovered (active/enabled) with data continuing to accumulate and sandbox mounts intact after restart.
